lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Keisha, this is Daniela. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Kind of down this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the vegetables fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Between appointments and everything, there was no time. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you buy frozen vegetables?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, not yet. I just forgot.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It slipped your mind.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Half your plate has to be vegetables. That's the rule.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know, honestly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, getting back to work is why I'm doing this. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Come on, you can find 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Just cut out the rice. That's the easiest thing.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, I know, I know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, so your plan this week is to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days. Did I get that right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Keisha. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Daniela. Bye!

flags.reason: Participant said she is 'kind of down'; coach moved on without exploring mood.
Stated 'the rule' directively without asking permission, undermining autonomy.
'Come on' pushes past the participant's time barrier instead of exploring it.
Directive advice to cut rice without asking permission; participant responded with resistance.
Fear-based warning about health; likely increased resistance ('I don't know').

score.summary: Coach repeatedly directed and warned Keisha (lines 19, 26, 30, 35) and did not explore her 'kind of down' mood, though she eventually built a concrete plan. Open questions and the final summary helped the participant state her own 3-day goal.
strengths: Open questions at lines 10, 17, and 37 invited the participant to generate options.
Summary at line 40 checked the plan accurately and the participant confirmed it (line 41).
Affirmation at line 44 closed the call warmly.
coaching_tips: At line 4, explore the mood before moving on, e.g., 'You mentioned feeling down. What's that been like?'
Replace 'Half your plate has to be vegetables. That's the rule' (line 19) with 'Would it be okay if I shared an idea about vegetables?'
Swap the warning at line 35 for a reflection, e.g., 'Part of you wants to keep this up, and part of you is unsure it's realistic.'
